redirects.method: Chrome, same-origin fetch() against every URL in the inventory. redirect:'follow' gives the final destination; redirect:'manual' returning type='opaqueredirect' confirms a server-level HTTP 3xx (rules out meta-refresh and JS redirects). The exact 3xx code (301 vs 302) is NOT readable in-browser: opaqueredirect masks the status, the CDP network log collapses redirect chains, and resource-timing entries are not exposed for these requests. Treat destination and existence as verified; treat permanence as unconfirmed.
anomalies: Series split unevenly: /understanding-dst-1031-exchanges/ and /understanding-dst-1031-exchanges-part-3/ redirect to the DST hub, but /understanding-dst-1031-exchanges-part-2/ is still live. Same for /10-reasons-to-consider-a-dst-1031-exchange/ (redirected) vs its /-part-2/ (live), and /comparing-investment-valuation-tools-part-1/ (redirected) vs parts 2 and 3 (live). Looks like partial cleanups that missed a page.

/bridge-financing-fund/ redirects to /1031cf-bridge-fund-iii/. That is an offering page redirecting to a specific fund; when Bridge Fund III closes, this will need repointing.

/education-center/ redirects to /education-center/blog/, so the Education Center hub URL is not itself a landing page. Worth confirming that is intentional, since it is the natural parent for the whole education cluster.
